ns2:course.label: Senior Project in CS II, ACP
ns2:course.description: Course is identical to CS 494 except for the additional writing component. See CS 494. 3 undergraduate hours. Students must enroll for a two term sequence, CS 492 and CS 493. Credit is not given for both CS 493 and a project course in another engineering department for the same project. Prerequisite: CS 492.
